First, we write the integral as

$$
\int \frac{5\operatorname{coth}⁡x-3\operatorname{csch}⁡x}{\operatorname{sinh}⁡x}\,\text{d}x=\int \frac{1}{\operatorname{sinh}⁡x}(5\operatorname{coth}⁡x-3\operatorname{csch}⁡x)\text{d}x.
$$

Now, recall the following identity:

$$
\operatorname{csch}⁡x=\frac{1}{\operatorname{sinh}⁡x}
$$

Then, we use the above identity to express the integral as

$$
\int \operatorname{csch}⁡x(5\operatorname{coth}⁡x-3\operatorname{csch}⁡x)\text{d}x.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{5\operatorname{coth}⁡x-3\operatorname{csch}⁡x}{\operatorname{sinh}⁡x}\,\text{d}x & =\int \operatorname{csch}⁡x(5\operatorname{coth}⁡x-3\operatorname{csch}⁡x)\text{d}x \\  & =5\int \operatorname{coth}⁡x\operatorname{csch}⁡x\,\text{d}x-3\int {csch}^{2}⁡x\,\text{d}x \\  & =-5\operatorname{csch}⁡x+3\operatorname{coth}⁡x+C.\end{aligned}
$$
